target_runtime: IBM AI Toolkit / ONNX Runtime (NNPA Execution Provider Draft)

Gemm.evidence: IBM z16 Technical Guide (SG24-8950) / Public NNPA Instruction Set Documentation
Gemm.notes: Offloaded to Integrated Accelerator for AI (NNPA). Optimal with static 2D dimensions.

Conv.evidence: IBM z16 Technical Guide / NNPA Architecture Specification
Conv.notes: Accelerated 2D convolution. Requires standard 4D NCHW tensor layout for hardware offload.

Relu.notes: Vectorized activation function implemented in on-chip coprocessor.

Softmax.evidence: IBM z16 Technical Guide / NNPA Architecture Specification
Softmax.notes: Normalized exponential computed directly on NNPA coprocessor.

MaxPool.evidence: IBM z16 Technical Guide / NNPA Architecture Specification
MaxPool.notes: Spatial max pooling offloaded to NNPA engine.

Add.notes: Element-wise tensor addition supported with broadcast limitations.

MatMul.evidence: IBM z16 Technical Guide / NNPA Architecture Specification
MatMul.notes: General matrix multiplication offloaded to NNPA.

Flatten.evidence: IBM z/OS and Linux on IBM Z Runtime Guidelines
Flatten.notes: CPU fallback / memory layout adjustment; not directly dispatched to NNPA.

NonZero.evidence: IBM AI Toolkit Known Limitations Draft
NonZero.notes: Dynamic sparsity selection operator is explicitly unsupported by target accelerator pipeline.

CustomZOp.notes: Requires experimental vendor shared library libznnpa_custom.so loaded into LD_LIBRARY_PATH.

known_limitations: ILLUSTRATIVE PROFILE: For evaluation only. Does not guarantee real IBM zSystems hardware execution.
Hardware acceleration requires static tensor shapes for NNPA coprocessor offload; dynamic batching may trigger CPU fallback.
Data types other than float32 and float16 (DLFloat) may fall back to host CPU execution.
Host system must have s390x instruction set level z16 (machine type 3931 or 3932) to utilize NNPA.
evidence_source: IBM z16 Technical Guide (SG24-8950) & Public NNPA Overview (Illustrative Adaptation)
